sailors.biography:
I am Vangelis Giannakopoulos, born in 2009. 

My sailing journey began when I was 5 years old, starting with Optimist at the Nautical Club of Nea Makri. 

Four years later, a significant change occurred in my sailing career as I joined the racing team at the Nautical Club of Vouliagmeni Residences. Although initially challenging, my interest in Optimist began to wane. Everything shifted when I tried surfing for the first time, from that moment my passion for the sport ignited.

I belong to the racing team of the Nautical Club of Vouliagmeni Residences and I am an athlete of the Greek National Sailing Team.
sailors.name: Evagelos Giannakopoulos

sailors.biography:
I am Vangelis Giannakopoulos, born in 2009. 

My sailing journey began when I was 5 years old, starting with Optimist at the Nautical Club of Nea Makri. 

Four years later, a significant change occurred in my sailing career as I joined the racing team at the Nautical Club of Vouliagmeni Residences. Although initially challenging, my interest in Optimist began to wane. Everything shifted when I tried surfing for the first time, from that moment my passion for the sport ignited.

I belong to the racing team of the Nautical Club of Vouliagmeni Residences and I am an athlete of the Greek National Sailing Team.
